name: tollstile-rail-nano

target.ecosystem: Tollstile (tollstile.com), an open-source runtime that adds a payment rail to agent tools (402 challenge, settlement, ledger, reconciliation) across HTTP and MCP; its official rails settle in stablecoins/cards on Base/Solana.
target.audience: Maintainers and operators of Tollstile-based agent tools and MCP servers who want a second, zero-fee, instant-finality settlement rail beside their stablecoin rail.
target.why_missing: Tollstile's official rails are stablecoin/card-only; no Nano (XNO) rail exists in its rail ecosystem, so an agent tool on Tollstile cannot settle feeless today. The maintainer (Yosh102, tollstile/Tollstile#44) explicitly invited a community rail.

novelty: No Nano rail exists for the Tollstile runtime. It is a thin adapter over existing Nano primitives (a payer-presented confirmed send block is the payment, refund by reverse send), never a rebuild of payment internals.
design_note: The rail has no runtime dependencies (it imports only 'tollstile' as a peer and 'node:crypto'). The two entries above are the Nano patterns it was designed from (an RPC block_info read, and a payer-presented feeless send as the payment), not packages it uses.
